answers.valueEn: The plastic cowl is attached to the front metal panel on the right with a clip and on the left with a screw. Seat covers installed. Traces of loosening bolts for the steering box and engine subframe. Traces of loosening the support in the front metal panel in the middle of the cooling set. Leaking engine mount (oil). Hit and warping in the right side sill edge from the front. Rust in the engine subframe and rust/bubbling paint under the vehicle floor. Hit in the front metal panel below the radiator. Driver's door armrest plastic needs fixing. Steering box replaced under warranty. Small spot paint repair on part of the front bumper, right side.
